plain: Having to do with worldly matters, not religious ones

webster.text: Pertaining to this life or this world or the body only; secular; as temporal concerns; temporal affairs.

example.quote: He asserted that the security of these rights to life, liberty, and property had been the object of all those struggles against arbitrary power, temporal and spiritual, civil and political, military and ecclesiastical, in every age.
example.cite: James Otis, Argument Against Writs of Assistance, 1761
